full_text_en:
Xingtai Municipal People's Procuratorate v. Chen Wenbing — intentional injury case

【Ruling Summary】

The defendant, being hired, gathered together and led others to injure the victim, which already constituted the crime of intentional injury and shall be punished according to law. However, given that the defendant did not directly carry out the act of injuring the victim, the act causing the victim's death committed by others exceeded the defendant's criminal intent, and the defendant had a good attitude in confessing after being brought to justice, a death sentence may not be executed immediately.

Criminal Judgment of the Supreme People's Court

Criminal Review No. 35 (2005)

Defendant Chen Wenbing, male, born on April 20, 1974, Han ethnicity, from Langao County, Shaanxi Province, education level of primary school, farmer, residing in Fangya Village, Chengguan Town, Langao County. Arrested on November 13, 2003. Currently in custody.

The Xingtai Intermediate People's Court of Hebei Province, having tried the case of the Xingtai Municipal People's Procuratorate charging the defendant Chen Wenbing with intentional injury, rendered a criminal judgment with civil damages on May 8, 2004, under (2004) Xing Xing Chu Zi No. 44, finding the defendant Chen Wenbing guilty of intentional injury, sentencing him to life imprisonment and deprivation of political rights for life. After the judgment was pronounced, Chen Wenbing accepted the sentence and did not appeal. The prosecutorial authority considered the first instance sentence against the defendant Chen Wenbing to be inappropriately lenient and filed a protest. The Hebei High People's Court, on December 24, 2004, rendered a criminal judgment with civil damages under (2004) Ji Xing Yi Zhong Zi No. 658, finding the defendant Chen Wenbing guilty of intentional injury, sentencing him to death and deprivation of political rights for life, and accordingly reported the case to this Court for approval. This Court lawfully formed a collegial panel to conduct a review of this case. The review is now concluded.

Upon review, the following facts were confirmed: Wang Yingqiu (a co-defendant in the same case, already sentenced) had a long-standing conflict with the victim Liu Qingchao over a housing lot issue and thus conceived the idea of retaliating against Liu Qingchao. In September 2003, Wang Yingqiu contacted the defendant Chen Wenbing and agreed that Wang Yingqiu would contribute RMB 5,000 and Chen Wenbing would be responsible for finding people to break Liu Qingchao's arms and legs. Wang Yingqiu also showed Chen Wenbing Liu Qingchao's residence. Later, Chen Wenbing gathered Ou Xuyin (a co-defendant in the same case, already sentenced), Mao Jun, Chen Shun, Xiao Hou, and another person from Shaanxi (the latter four are all at large). At approximately 11:30 p.m. on October 5, 2003, they drove to Liu Qingchao's residence. Chen Shun stayed outside to watch the car. Chen Wenbing called out but no one answered the door. The other five smashed open the door of Liu Qingchao's room with stones, rushed into the room with knives and iron pipes respectively. Chen Wenbing used a knife to restrain Liu Qingchao's wife, while the others used knives and iron pipes to beat Liu Qingchao to death. Forensic examination confirmed that Liu Qingchao died of hemorrhagic shock caused by sharp instrument stabbing. Before and after the incident, Chen Wenbing received a total of RMB 3,700 from Wang Yingqiu in three installments.

The above facts are confirmed by the autopsy report, crime scene investigation record, witness testimony, and confessions of co-defendants. The defendant Chen Wenbing also confessed, which is sufficient to establish.

Opinion of the Court: The defendant Chen Wenbing, hired to injure another person, gathered together and led others to the victim's residence to carry out the injurious act, which already constituted the crime of intentional injury and shall be punished according to law. The facts found in the first and second instance judgments are clear, the evidence is reliable and sufficient, and the conviction is accurate. The trial procedures were lawful. In the commission of the joint crime, Chen Wenbing was the organizer and a principal offender, and shall be punished according to law for all crimes he organized or directed. In view of the circumstances that the act of stabbing the victim to death by other perpetrators exceeded Chen Wenbing's criminal intent, Chen Wenbing did not directly injure the victim, and he had a good attitude in confessing after being brought to justice, a death sentence imposed on Chen Wenbing may not be executed immediately.

In accordance with Article 199 of the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, Item (3) of Article 285 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Implementation of the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, and Paragraph 2 of Article 234, Paragraph 1 and Paragraph 4 of Article 26, Paragraph 1 of Article 48, and Paragraph 1 of Article 57 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China, the judgment is as follows:

1. The sentencing portion of the criminal judgment with civil damages (2004) Ji Xing Yi Zhong Zi No. 658 of the Hebei High People's Court against the defendant Chen Wenbing is set aside.

2. The defendant Chen Wenbing is found guilty of intentional injury and sentenced to death, suspended for two years, and deprivation of political rights for life.

This judgment shall become legally effective upon service.

Presiding Judge: Zhou Feng

Judge: Li Yanming

Acting Judge: Wu Wenhe

April 25, 2005

Clerk: Li Xiuyuan

[About the Presiding Judge]
Zhou Feng, Senior Judge: born in 1958, holds a master's degree in law, served as a judge of the Supreme People's Court since 1999.
